settings.question: What is Perito Moreno all about?
settings.answer: Perito Moreno is an Indian perfume house dedicated to crafting innovative fragrances using natural ingredients and rare materials. We aim to make high-quality scents accessible to everyone at an exceptional price.

settings.question: Who is the perfumer for Perito Moreno?
settings.answer: Our perfumes are blended by Mr. Nitish Dixit, a Chemical Engineer with a Master’s in Polymer Engineering and over 10 years of experience in perfume blending, distillation, and extraction techniques.

settings.question: Is Perito Moreno IFRA compliant?
settings.answer: We prioritize the use of exclusive and natural raw materials. While not all our offerings are fully IFRA-compliant yet, several are, and we’re working toward greater compliance without compromising our creative vision.

settings.question: Who is Gallaed Cosmetics?
settings.answer: Gallaed Cosmetics is our partner for alcohol licensing and legal manufacturing. With more than 40 years of contract manufacturing expertise, they ensure our fragrances meet regulatory and safety standards.

settings.question: Where are Perito Moreno perfumes made?
settings.answer: All Perito Moreno perfumes are proudly produced in India. We source top-quality raw materials from around the globe, along with select Indian botanicals, and even distill certain ingredients in our own facility.

settings.question: Are Perito Moreno perfumes safe to use on skin?
settings.answer: Yes! We formulate our fragrances with skin safety in mind. However, everyone’s skin is unique, so we always recommend a quick patch test. Spray a small amount on a small area of skin—if you experience any irritation, discontinue use on skin and feel free to spray on clothes instead.

settings.question: What inspired the name “Perito Moreno”?
settings.answer: We drew inspiration from the Perito Moreno glacier’s awe-inspiring natural beauty, purity, and rarity to reflect our commitment to using exceptional raw materials in each fragrance.

settings.question: How does Perito Moreno reflect its Indian roots?
settings.answer: While we source materials internationally, we’re deeply proud of our Indian heritage. We incorporate traditional Indian distillation methods and native botanicals, merging modern techniques with age-old perfumery traditions.

settings.question: Can I test a fragrance before buying?
settings.answer: Yes. We recommend trying a sample or discovery set before committing to a full-size bottle whenever available.

settings.question: Do perfumes expire?
settings.answer: Perfumes can change over time, especially when exposed to heat, sunlight, or air. Proper storage helps maintain their quality for longer.
